description:
Check (and if allowed, record) a proposed act against a covenant.
    Deny-by-default. Idempotent on act_id — retries never double-consume
    budget. Every check lands on the audit chain.

act_id.description: Your id for this act; a retry with the same act_id never double-spends.
act_id.title: Act Id

amount_minor.description: Spend for this act in minor units. Default 0.
amount_minor.title: Amount Minor

covenant_id.description: The covenant id returned by grant_covenant.
covenant_id.title: Covenant Id

scope.description: The action being attempted, for example payments.send.
scope.title: Scope

name: check_act
title: Check act
